entities.name: PMID:27511352
observations: In sublethally irradiated NOD/SCID mice receiving human umbilical cord-blood mononuclear cells, placental mesenchymal stem cells increased human hematopoietic-cell recovery in tibiae versus cord-blood cells alone; intrabone marrow delivery was more effective than intravenous delivery.
The available abstract reports directional results but no exact percentages, fold changes, marrow-cellularity values, progenitor counts, survival data, or peripheral blood counts.

entities.name: IBMI enhances PMSC support
observations: In the mouse PMSC experiment, intrabone marrow injection produced greater hematopoietic support than intravenous injection, based on higher human hematopoietic-cell recovery in tibiae.
